squat.guidelines: Place the phone side-on at hip height about 2.8 m away. Your knees, hips, and the bar path must stay in frame for the entire rep. Avoid angling the camera up — keep it level.

deadlift.guidelines: Position the phone at hip height 3 m away on your side. The bar path from the floor to lockout must be fully visible. Keep the camera level to ensure proper form analysis.

pushup.guidelines: Place the phone low and close, 2.2 m away, capturing your entire body from head to toes. The elbow bend and shoulder position are critical — get the camera angle right so your arms and torso are clearly visible.

diamond_pushup.guidelines: Set the phone low and centered 2.2 m away to capture your full body. Diamond push-ups demand tight elbow control — the camera must show your hand position and arm alignment clearly.

barbell_row.guidelines: Position the phone at upper torso height 2.8 m to your side. The bar, your elbows, and spine position during the row must stay in frame. Maintain a level camera to catch form deviations.

barbell_dead_row.guidelines: Place the phone at shoulder height 2.8 m away on your side. Capture the bar path and hip hinge position from start to finish. Keep the camera steady and level.

barbell_shrug.guidelines: Place the phone at shoulder level 2.5 m away, front or side. The bar and shoulder elevation are the focus — ensure the bar and shoulders remain in frame throughout the movement.

one_arm_row.guidelines: Set the phone at shoulder height 2.5 m to your side. The dumbbell, your rowing elbow, and trunk rotation must all be visible. Avoid twisting the camera — keep it perpendicular to your body.

dumbbell_overhead_shoulder_press.guidelines: Face the phone 2.0 m away. Both dumbbells and your full arm path from shoulder to lockout must be visible. Keep your head still and capture the complete range of motion.

neutral_overhead_shoulder_press.guidelines: Stand facing the phone 2.0 m away. Ensure both dumbbells and your shoulders are centered in frame. Neutral grip demands proper shoulder alignment — the camera must capture elbow and wrist position.

dumbbell_biceps_curls.guidelines: Face the phone 1.8 m away at chest height. Both dumbbells and the full arc of your curl must be visible. Keep your upper arms stationary — the camera should clearly show elbow angle and shoulder stability.

dumbbell_hammer_curls.guidelines: Stand 1.8 m in front of the phone at chest level. The neutral grip and curl arc are critical — capture both dumbbells from start to peak contraction without motion blur.

dumbbell_curl_trifecta.guidelines: Position yourself 1.8 m in front of the phone at chest height. The varying grip positions and elbow angles must all be visible. Keep the frame stable to capture each phase of the trifecta.

drag_curl.guidelines: Face the phone 1.8 m away at chest level. The drag curl's unique elbow path — kept tight to the body — must be clearly visible. Capture the entire range without allowing the bar to drift forward.

dumbbell_reverse_lunge.guidelines: Place the phone at hip height 2.5 m to your side. Your front and rear knee angles, hip position, and torso alignment must all stay in frame. Avoid angling up — level camera is essential.

dumbbell_high_pulls.guidelines: Stand facing the phone 2.0 m away. The dumbbell path from hip to shoulder height and elbow position are critical. Capture the explosive pull and elbow drive clearly.

dumbbell_scaptions.guidelines: Face the phone 1.8 m away at shoulder height. The scaption plane (45° angle) and dumbbell path must be visible. Keep your torso still — the focus is shoulder mobility and control.

side_lateral_raise.guidelines: Stand 2.0 m in front of the phone. Both dumbbells and shoulder abduction arc must be fully visible. Keep the frame centered on your shoulders — arm elevation and elbow angle are key.

overhead_trap_raises.guidelines: Face the phone 2.0 m away at chest level. The dumbbells must travel overhead with minimal torso lean. Capture the full lockout and trap engagement clearly.

w_raise.guidelines: Stand 1.8 m from the phone at shoulder height. The W position of your arms and rear delt engagement must be visible. Maintain posture — any spinal drift will affect form analysis.

band_pull_apart.guidelines: Face the camera 2.0 m away at chest height. The band and arm position throughout the pull must be clear. Capture shoulder external rotation and scapular retraction.

burpees.guidelines: Place the phone 2.8 m away to capture your entire body. The squat, push-up, and jump phases must all be visible. Landscape orientation is needed for the full range of motion.

clean_and_press.guidelines: Set the phone 3.0 m to your side at hip height. The bar path from floor through catch position and overhead lockout must be fully visible. Keep the camera level for proper depth analysis.

man_maker.guidelines: Place the phone low and centered 2.8 m away. The push-up position and rowing motion must both be visible. Landscape is essential to capture the full plank range.

mule_kick.guidelines: Set the phone low 2.5 m away to capture your full body in plank. The glute kick and arm stability are critical — the camera must show the complete range without obstruction.

overhead_extension_thruster.guidelines: Position the phone 2.5 m away to capture your full body. The squat dip, explosive drive, and overhead lockout must all be visible. Landscape orientation shows the complete compound movement.

standing_ab_twists.guidelines: Place the phone 2.0 m away at hip height to capture your full torso. The rotational range and core engagement must be visible. Keep the camera centered — rotation should be around the vertical axis.
